# React

> React is a JavaScript library for building interactive user interfaces with reusable components, hooks, and server-side rendering capabilities.

React.dev is the official documentation and community hub for React, maintained by the React Foundation and the open-source community. It provides comprehensive guides, API references, and updates on React's latest features including React Server Components and the React Compiler.

## Key Topics

- React
- JSX
- React Hooks
- Components
- State Management
- React Server Components
- React Compiler
- Interactive UI
- Web Framework
- JavaScript
- React Native
- React Foundation
- React Conf

## Getting Started

- [React](https://react.dev): React library for building web and native UIs with components, JSX, and hooks

## Community & Updates

- [React Blog](https://react.dev/blog): Official React blog with release notes, security updates, and React Conf news
